Coram : V.N. KHARE*, BRIJESH KUMAR, S.B. SINHA
Arbitration : Arbitration Act, 1940 : Section 4l(b) proviso-Interim order-Passing of-Powers of Arbitrator-Held: Arbitrator does not have power to pass an interim order in the absence of any specific agreement in relation thereto. B c Section 30-Award-Misconduct by Arbitrator-Setting aside of D dealing with rights and liabilities of parties-Held: Such a conduct amounted to legal misconduct on the part of the Arbitrator-Hence, award liable to be set aside.
